title: One Folder, AI Help
hook_vo: Keep your show in one folder, and let an AI help.

beats.vo: Bring outside files in, before the stick comes loose.
Everything you make is ordinary files, in one folder.
On a narrow screen, panels fold into their own windows.
And any AI chat can rewrite your slides.
